output.advice: Redraw as a closed, filled silhouette of a driftwood frame, not a gold wireframe kite. Keep the orientation: top bow at 94083 (about 207,128), foot at 94376 (about 169,378). Build the silhouette as a narrow trapezoid. Draw a spine from 94083 down through 94648 at (183,216), moving 94648 onto the exact line between 94083 and 94376. Make both arms flare outward: 97433 at (94,288) and 92782 at (224,279) should be wide flared ends, not sharp points. Add a sagging cross-spar from 97433 to 92782, dipping through 96100 at (129,313)-ish so the bridle knot sits on the spar. At 94376 add two hanging cloth tails extending downward from the foot. Remove the detached blue loop at top-left, or redraw it as a fill that belongs to the frame. Shorten labels so they stay inside the canvas and do not overlap stars.
